fields.title: Permutations
fields.description: Array of conditional component overrides. Each permutation has a Molang condition and components that override the base components when the condition is true.

fields.title: Components
fields.technicalDescription: Block cannot have both a "container" in "minecraft:block_entity" and a "minecraft:crafting_table" component.

fields.title: Description
fields.description: Information about the block, must have at minimum an "identifier" and can have also the following optional field "menu_category", "states" and/or "traits"

description: Is a block definition with description, components, and permutations.
